title: Define DataBase as the ContentMRS 2.0 Semantic Corpus Engine
notes: ContentMRS 2.0 makes Semantic Corpus the core asset. DataBase owns fact/commentary/style/allusion/poetry/lexicon/structure/author-memory semantic units and retrieval projections; ContentBase only packs context and calls a single writer. This claim is a coordination signal for the next implementation pass, not a lock.
